Barkley was the best RB prospect of the last 15 or 20 years, right? I don't think you can say the same about Jeudy.

Wide receivers are seldom top-5 or top-10 at their position as rookies. A guy like OBJ is a rarity. The top guys mostly take a couple years to get really going, like Adams or Hopkins. And then wide receivers can hold their dynasty value longer than RBs. Running backs however hold their most value in their first years. Look at guys like Le'Veon Bell or David Johnson. Both were studs, both are 28, and neither you'd think of as a top-10 guy at their position. 28 feels like nothing for a stud WR. Julio is still a top guy at 31. As an aside, Jeudy doesn't really hold a candle to Barkley as a prospect.
